title: dianthus montivagus
intro: Dianthus montivagus, commonly known as mountain pink or alpine pink, is a species of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion due to its high antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus montivagus include its calming effects, which can help alleviate anxiety and stress, as well as its antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
